title: Family-wise Top-k depth profile across 42 fixed rule configurations

hypothesis.h0: For each K in {5,10,20}, the mean per-target maximum overlap across the fixed 42-rule TopK family is no greater than its conditional uniform 5-of-40 randomization expectation.
hypothesis.h1: At least one K in {5,10,20} has positive mean maximum-overlap lift in the final chronological Blind OOS segment after Holm correction across the three K endpoints.
hypothesis.statistic: M_{K,t}=max_{j=1..42}|D_t intersect TopK_{j,t}| for K in {5,10,20}.
hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Family of three Blind OOS mean lifts versus target-specific conditional randomization expectation; one-sided positive alternatives; Holm family size 3.
hypothesis.interpretation: Measures family-wise rank-depth profile only. Does not validate any single rule as a production predictor.

design.candidate_family: The same 42 fixed rule configurations and their prior-only ordered Top5/Top10/Top20 lists from historical_rule_ledger.csv, separately evaluated at K=5,10,20.
design.null: For each target and each replicate, independently draw one uniform 5-of-40 quintet and compute the maximum overlap against the same target's 42 TopK candidate sets. Reuse each random quintet across K to preserve cross-endpoint dependence.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of observed M_{K,t} minus target-specific Monte Carlo null expectation

inference.blind_oos: one-sided randomization p-values with plus-one correction
inference.confidence_intervals: two-sided 95% paired circular moving-block bootstrap intervals

prospective_observation.role: separate descriptive exact-enumeration check only; excluded from historical walk-forward, canonical archive and Q60 until official combination publication

limitations: The 42-rule family was selected after the archive; conditional randomization conditions on the fixed candidate sets but does not correct that broader selection history.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout and is not prospective confirmation.
Holm correction covers only the three Q130 rank-depth endpoints, not the broader Q00-Q129 research family.
The conditional null assumes independent uniform 5-of-40 draws.
